gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i2: remove() before any next() call must throw IllegalStateException, because there is no current element to remove yet.
ADDED i4: After consuming an element with next(), remove() is allowed and delegates to the underlying iterator without error.
ADDED i5: With max = 0 no element is within bounds, so next() throws NoSuchElementException even if the source could supply elements.
ADDED i7: Construction with an offset larger than the source size is valid: the constructor advances the (empty) mock iterator and stops once hasNext() reports false.
ADDED i8: forEachRemaining over an empty bounded iterator never invokes the action, so even a null-backed closure is harmless.
ADDED i9: An empty source yields no elements, so hasNext() returns false.
ADDED i10: A negative max is rejected by the constructor with IllegalArgumentException.
ADDED i12: A negative offset is rejected before the iterator is even dereferenced, so the offset check fires ahead of any null check on the source.
